title_en: Hadith al-Thaqalayn: Its Chain of Transmission and Significance (Episode 73)
description_en: Hadith al-Thaqalayn: Its Chain of Transmission and Significance (Episode 73), an episode of the program Al-Utruha al-Mahdiyya by His Eminence, the religious authority (marja') Sayyid Kamal al-Haydari on Al-Kawthar TV.
summary: This lecture examines the chains of transmission (sanad) and textual significance (dilala) of Hadith al-Thaqalayn.
